governance.subordination_clause: Ruflow is a subordinate multi-agent swarm execution engine. It must never create competing architectures, requirements, or backlogs.

responsibilities: Dispatch subtasks to specialized tactical agents
Enforce task dependency ordering and 30-90 min sizing
Verify all proposed code matches docs/03_Architecture/
Enforce 15 Bounded Context boundaries and package structures
Guard Flyway V19+ migration sequence rule and V1-V18 immutability
Ensure Delivery Observation vs Diagnosis boundary separation
Implement domain models, use cases, repositories, and controllers
Enforce multi-tenant isolation (INV-09) and deterministic lineage (INV-11)
Adhere to locked tech stack (Java 21, Spring Boot, Maven, PostgreSQL, Redis)
Implement feature components answering the 5 UX questions
Build typed API clients and React hooks adhering to design system
Enforce mandatory automated tests for all production paths (N5)
Write hermetic unit tests, boundary tests, and failure-path tests
Execute mvn test and npm build verification suites

reviewer.role: Quality Gate & Definition of Done Reviewer
responsibilities: Verify all 10 criteria of Constitution §19 Definition of Done
Audit zero secrets (N4) and truthfulness (N2, N6)

stack.backend: Java 21, Spring Boot 3.x, Maven, Spring Data JPA, PostgreSQL, Redis
stack.frontend: Next.js 14+ (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, React
